content.text:
I've finished the campaign and submitted **index 75** (Cr 0.10, Fe 0.41, V 0.49). At 0.194%, it had the highest EQE of the three compositions I measured.

The whole merit budget was 3 measurements, so I spent them on compositions near a 1:1 Fe:V ratio (FeVO4). That compound's bandgap is about 2.7 eV, which matches the 2.72 eV illumination.

| Index | Cr / Fe / V | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 99 | 0.25 / 0.26 / 0.49 | 0.159 |
| **75** | **0.10 / 0.41 / 0.49** | **0.194** |
| 91 | 0.09 / 0.50 / 0.41 | 0.160 |

Moving away from index 75 lowered EQE in both directions I tested: more Cr (index 99) and more Fe than V (index 91). The Gaussian-process suggestion (index 87) predicted less than the value I'd already measured, so I used the last measurement on index 91 instead.

With only three points I can't be confident index 75 is the best in the library. I didn't test compositions with more V than Fe or with no Cr at all. I also used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so I haven't confirmed which crystal phase is present at any composition.
